On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

name: arc-collinear-marker-bridges
description: Use when ARC grids contain sparse same-color markers with demos suggesting straight-line bridges. Infer row/column interpolation and preserve markers.
---

# ARC collinear marker bridges

When a sparse marker grid has a demo where a second color appears in straight segments between markers:

1. Compare marker pairs sharing a row or column. Identify whether the output fills the cells between adjacent markers along each such line, leaving the original marker cells unchanged.
2. Check the demo carefully for exceptions: whether all aligned pairs are connected or only nearest neighbors, whether segments are filled inclusively/exclusively, and whether intersections change color.
3. Apply the demonstrated rule independently to every row and column in the test grid. Preserve background and marker colors; color only intervening cells.
4. Verify dimensions and ensure no marker was overwritten.

In the observed example, original markers were 1 on background 9 and the bridge color was 3; segments were placed between consecutive markers in each row/column. The next example used marker 7, background 1, and bridge 3, with the same consecutive-collinear-marker rule.
